object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests. The dialog-opening tests call the window's commit routine rather than trigger the action.
object.description: Open CHILD in the Document Editor, leave read-only mode, change an object and commit from the window; separately check the Commit action on a clean document, and choose it on a document with a validation error. Expected: the Commit action is enabled; committing opens one commit dialog, prefilled for CHILD, and accepting it commits CHILD.
